entries.lead: Tuning receipts count only rendered, applied tuning
entries.text: Harness session statements that baselines also issue (on Snowflake TIMEZONE, AUTOCOMMIT, USE_CACHED_RESULT, QUERY_TAG and USE WAREHOUSE) are recorded as harness_default and no longer count as applied tuning. A ledger holding only such session statements reads noop, a failed tuning session setting blocks verification, and counts.tuning_types and counts.tables_tuned derive from executed ledger statements.
details: Platforms whose configure step applies tuning-derived session settings (the PostgreSQL family and ClickHouse OLAP settings) tag them with mechanism session_config.
Snowflake primary and foreign key intents stay classified unverifiable because introspection reads no key constraints.
